text:
Priya: Heads-up: Prospect X asked for a short security pack for tomorrow's 9:30am ET call. Items requested: recent RBAC deltas, sample immutable audit export + signed checksum, KMS envelope diagram (private deploy flow), HSM attestation references, vuln triage notes and IR runbook. Can we split up the artifacts?

Arjun: I can do the RBAC delta csv and a one-line summary of role changes. Will redact emails.

Talia: I'll take the audit export. Plan: run export -> compute SHA256 -> sign with our sig-key -> upload signed manifest. Do we need notarization or customer just wants a signature?

Priya: They asked explicitly for "non-repudiable proof". Signed manifest should be fine; if they ask for timestamping, we'll discuss.

Omar: KMS envelope flow + HSM attestation pointers assigned to me. I'll include envelope JSON example and SOPS-friendly keywrap note. Also list cert object paths.

sre-oncall: FYI logs: pipeline shows recent CreateSession entries; example query: `logName=projects/redwood/logs/audit AND protoPayload.methodName="CreateSession"`. We can include 2 sanitized lines. Retention policy is 365 days for audit events; lifecycle rules and legal hold process are documented.

Arjun: RBAC csv format: principal, prev_roles, new_roles, changed_by, changed_at. Will output as `rbac_delta_2026-03-25.csv`. I'll hash user emails with `sha256(email)` and include a private mapping file for internal reviewers.

Talia: Starting export now. ETA ~20m. Will post `audit-export-5549991234.tar.gz` and `audit-export-5549991234.manifest.json` with SHA256 and signature.

Omar: Sample envelope: `{\n  "ciphertext":"<base64>",\n  "wrapped_key":"<base64>",\n  "kms_key_ref":"projects/…/locations/…/keyRings/…/cryptoKeys/…"\n}`

Omar: Attestation certs live in `s3://secure-attest/vaulthsm/2026-03/` — I'll include full object names and vendor attestation pdf names. Note: we don't yet have a FIPS-HSM option in private deploy; I'll put roadmap note.

Priya: We need at least two reviewers before external share. sec-bot will enforce. Please ping when artifacts are uploaded.

Arjun: Uploaded scrubbed CSV to `s3://sec-artefacts/prospectX/5549991234/rbac_delta.csv`. Redacted auth emails.

Talia: Audit export uploaded: `s3://sec-artefacts/prospectX/5549991234/audit-export.tar.gz`. Manifest SHA256: `c1d9f50f86825a1a2302ec2449c1a5b8`. Signature file `audit-export-5549991234.sig` uploaded too.

Omar: Uploaded `kms-envelope-private.pdf` and `vaulthsm-attest-list.json` (paths) to the same bucket. Marked vendor attestation cert filenames.

sre-oncall: Pasted 2 sanitized log entries into `s3://sec-artefacts/prospectX/5549991234/log-sample.txt` (IPs removed, uids hashed).

Priya: Who can review? Need two approvals.

Arjun: Happy to review KMS artifacts and attest notes.

Omar: I'll review the audit manifest and signature process.

sec-bot: Reminder: checklist requires (1) artifacts present, (2) 2 reviewers, (3) artifacts index, (4) approval for external share.

Arjun: Added a short review comment: LGTM on CSV and redaction approach.

Omar: LGTM on manifest signature and attestation object list. Added one minor doc fix.

sec-bot: Checklist status: [x] artifacts present, [x] 2 reviewers, [ ] artifacts index, [ ] external share approval.

Priya: I'll create the artifacts index and assemble the PDF pack, then request external share approval. ETA 30m.

Talia: Quick note for the call: customer asked about patch cadence and triage SLAs. Ben from SecOps usually handles SLA questions; I'll add our standard MTTR numbers and the IR quick-runbook link.

Priya: Uploaded final PDF bundle to `secure-share/prospectX/pack-5549991234.pdf` and posted index at `s3://sec-artefacts/prospectX/5549991234/index.txt`. Requesting external share now.

sec-bot: External share approval requested. Please wait for compliance ok.

sre-oncall: If they ask for evidence of retention enforcement, we can demo lifecycle policies and a sample deletion audit entry.

Priya: Thanks team. If compliance approves, I'll send the secure link to the prospect during the call. Reopen thread if any follow-ups.

sec-bot: Compliance approved for external share (audit trail recorded).
